name: Mevlâna Museum
scope: The historic dervish lodge and Mevlâna Museum at Konya, with the turquoise Kubbe-i Hadra, ritual and prayer rooms, court fountain and tombs, and the mapped dervish-cell and kitchen wings.
era: Standing museum and restored Green Dome

originalReview.notes: Shows the turquoise lobed cone, grey lead domes, ashlar masses and the museum’s single minaret. The two minarets farther to the west belong to a separate mosque.

review.notes: Searched Qualla media first. Its exact CC0 Molavi1 original matches the native photographer’s first upload, authorship and CC0 release. Used the measured plans and written museum and restoration facts for other surfaces.
